name: v1.109.0
body:
## Verify this release ```bash cosign verify \ --key https://raw.githubusercontent.com/BerriAI/litellm/e82a3c646908ba0a6ee0beddc4310d7a6cac4065/cosign.pub \ ghcr.io/berriai/litellm:v1.109.0 ``` Same command for `litellm-database`, `litellm-non_root` and the `docker.io/litellm/*` images ## What's new in 1.109.0 982 PRs. 144 added, 424 fixed, 60 changed, 17 improved, 9 removed. 5 need action ### Action required - **Routing and fallbacks:** Change string fallback targets to lists of model names (#48943) - **Caching:** Switch `cache_params.type` from `disk` to `local` or `redis`, since the `disk` cache backend (diskcache) has been removed (#48114) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Add `optional_pre_call_checks: ["enforce_model_rate_limits"]` to keep a hard `rpm` cap on deployments (#48873) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Set `drop_params: true` or stop sending `temperature`, `top_p` and `top_k` to Gemini 3.6 Flash, 3.5 Flash-Lite and newer (#47645) - **Deployment:** Deploy Lens from its own chart and set `lens.*` in your values (#49169) ### Highlights - **Admin UI:** Added a Chat UI with a model hub, image generation and usage metrics (#48108) - **Routing and fallbacks:** Added mid-stream fallback continuation so a streaming chat cut off mid-answer continues on the configured fallback (#41127) - **Deployment:** Added `LITELLM_OFFLINE_MODE` to turn off every fetch LiteLLM makes on its own with one switch (#48096) - **Cost tracking and pricing:** Added `model_info.pricing_provider` to price a deployment from another provider's catalog rates instead of $0 (#47620) - **Vertex AI and Gemini:** Added Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS support, including multi-speaker voices and `mp3`, `opus`, `alaw` and `mulaw` output (#31915) - **SDK:** Fixed tool calls on `completion()` and `responses()` failing with `No module named 'mcp'` on base SDK installs (#45961) Also in [1.108.4](https://github.com/BerriAI/litellm/releases/tag/v1.108.4) ### All changes
OpenAI (19) - Added per-deployment workload identity on non-chat routes, realtime and the moderation guardrail (#39966) - Added the 12-hour cache write rate for `gpt-5.6-cyber` (#48246) - Added OpenAI `gpt-6.1-terra` with pricing (#48429) - Added Batch and Ultrafast 12-hour cache write rates for OpenAI models (#48433) - Added `gpt-6-rosalind` to the model cost map with its published prices (#49268) - Added `gpt-6-astra-law` with pricing from the OpenAI pricing page (#49444) - Fixed 400 errors and $0 spend logs on `gpt-transcribe` calls without `response_format` (#44021) - Fixed nonstreaming `aiohttp_openai` responses dropping `service_tier` (#47263) - Fixed `prompt_cache_retention` such as `24h` being silently dropped instead of sent upstream (#47480) - Fixed `/health` marking OpenAI and Azure audio chat models unhealthy (#47730) - Fixed OpenAI `context_length_exceeded` errors raising `BadRequestError` instead of `ContextWindowExceededError` (#47954) - Fixed 12-hour prompt cache writes on `openai/gpt-5.6` and newer billing at the 30-minute rate (#48088) - Fixed uncatalogued ChatGPT models hitting an unsupported Chat Completions endpoint (#48244) - Fixed the whole `reasoning_effort` dict not being sent when chat is bridged to Responses (#48807) - Fixed 400 `invalid_beta` on Agents API calls through the OpenAI passthrough (#49009) - Fixed empty `e.response.text` on OpenAI and Azure errors so the upstream error body is readable (#49079) - Changed OpenAI 401 and 404 `invalid_request_error` to raise matching exceptions, not `BadRequestError` (#32537) - Changed the ChatGPT session id to derive from `prompt_cache_key` for stable cache affinity (#42014) - Changed `gpt-6-luna` Decisions cache rates to the standard cached and write rates (#48066)
Azure (18) - Added Entra ID auth, including keyless auth, for Azure Decisions on `/v1/decisions` and `/v1/systemone` (#46539, #48529) - Added access to Foundry agents through the project Responses API for `azure_ai/agents/` (#47717) - Added `azure_ai/MAI-Code-1.1-Flash` (#47779) - Added `max_input_tokens` of 32768 for `azure_ai/Microsoft-Decision-1` (#48434) - Added `outputContentFormat=markdown` support on `/ocr` for Azure Document Intelligence (#48926) - Fixed Foundry chat requests losing OpenAI prompt cache breakpoints (#45299) - Fixed `/v1/responses` 404 on dated `api_version` deployments and `azure_ai` Grok reasoning token billing (#46377) - Fixed under-billed Grok reasoning tokens on `azure_ai` when the deployment name lacks "grok" (#46969) - Fixed Azure realtime over WebRTC failing with a 404 on `client_secrets` and an invalid token on the SDP exchange (#47316) - Fixed 400 from Foundry when tool results contain `tool_reference` parts on chat (#48032) - Fixed 400 on `azure_ai/claude-*` when using `thinking.block_binding` (#48033) - Fixed Responses API calls that use an explicit v1 Azure base URL (#48118) - Fixed 404 on Azure vector store retrieve, update and delete (#48224) - Fixed null audio capability metadata on two Azure audio snapshot models (#48475) - Fixed Azure `context_length_exceeded` raising `BadRequestError` so `context_window_fallbacks` never ran (#48616) - Fixed batch calls on unversioned `azure/` o3, o4-mini, o3-mini, gpt-4o and gpt-4o-mini billing at the standard rate (#49182) - Changed `max_input_tokens` to 128000 for `gpt-chat-latest` on Azure (#48252) - Improved Entra auth by reusing credentials and tokens across requests and refreshing them off the event loop (#46421, #47348, #48769)
Anthropic (16) - Fixed a fake `[System: ...]` message being added to tool-call-only assistant turns sent to Anthropic (#34822) - Fixed PDFs sent as chat `image_url` being rejected with 400 by sending them as document blocks (#46984) - Fixed Claude `json_schema` answers losing keys listed only in `required` and escaping non-ASCII characters (#47478) - Fixed replayed `redacted_thinking` blocks being dropped, and Bedrock Converse 400s when sent twice (#47489) - Fixed `clear_tool_uses` `input_tokens` trigger ignoring the system prompt, which delayed clearing (#47857) - Fixed native Anthropic responses omitting a null `stop_sequence` (#47987) - Fixed streamed responses leaving native web search fees out of the reconstructed usage cost (#48528) - Fixed `drop_params` not dropping `speed` on `claude-opus-4-7`, which Anthropic rejects with 400 (#48764) - Fixed 400 from beta-gated body fields when `drop_params: true`, including Claude Code and Codex traffic (#48793) - Fixed `model_context_window_exceeded` being reported as `stop` instead of `length` (#48874) - Fixed 400 on `/v1/messages` with many strict tools under `drop_params` by retrying without `strict` (#49102) - Fixed Claude `pause_turn` reported as finished and refusal explanations dropped on chat and Responses (#49192) - Fixed 500 on a non-string role or tool call id, now a 400 that names the field (#49237) - Fixed `metadata.user_id` being dropped on Anthropic `/v1/messages` pass-through routes (#49333) - Changed the default `max_tokens` for unmapped Anthropic models from 4096 to 128000 (#48502) - Changed the opening prompt usage estimate in the Chat Completions adapter to be off by default (#48633)
AWS Bedrock (28) - Added context and output token limits for the Nova Sonic models (#48247) - Added pricing for native `guardrailConfig` trace usage to spend and `x-litellm-response-cost` (#48278) - Added `global.openai.gpt-6.1-terra` and `us.openai.gpt-6.1-terra` Bedrock models with pricing (#48441) - Added token counting for three Mantle-native Bedrock Claude models (#48682) - Added published Priority, Batch and Flex prices to 46 Bedrock regional rows (#49113) - Fixed Bedrock Voxtral transcription returning 400, logging $0 spend and ignoring `language` (#41565) - Fixed `Unknown provider=None` 404 for Bedrock models missing from the cost map (#43290) - Fixed 400 errors on Bedrock Kimi K3 Converse calls with `max_tokens` below 16 (#43875) - Fixed 400 `invalid beta flag` on Claude Code auto mode requests that carry no `safeguards` (#44471) - Fixed a malformed Bedrock batch JSONL line failing the upload with a 500 instead of a 400 (#45992) - Fixed `post_call` guardrails not scanning Claude output on `invoke-with-response-stream` passthrough (#46524) - Fixed Claude `json_schema` streams dropping reasoning and thinking blocks and ending on `tool_calls` with no tool calls (#46863) - Fixed JSON schema requests failing on Fable 5 and Sonnet 4.6 and losing adaptive thinking on Haiku 5.5 (#46870) - Fixed `bedrock_request_metadata_fields` being ignored on the `/bedrock` pass-through routes (#47040) - Fixed Bedrock Opus 4.8 and Sonnet 5 dropping reasoning on `json_schema` requests by trying native output first (#47100) - Fixed Bedrock batch jobs ignoring a configured control-plane endpoint (#47260) - Fixed AWS region lookups through Vault blocking the event loop and stalling other requests on the worker (#47331) - Fixed $0 spend and `ModelNotMappedError` for `bedrock/claude_platform/` calls (#48150) - Fixed `max_input_tokens` to 922000 on Bedrock GPT models and added Mantle token counting for `claude-opus-5-5` (#48479) - Fixed Bedrock rejecting `strict` tool schemas by retrying without `strict` under `drop_params` (#48733) - Fixed 400 on Bedrock when Codex repeats its tool list across turns (#49006) - Fixed region-prefixed Bedrock embedding models not routing to their region or billing its price (#49072) - Fixed `bedrock_mantle/openai.gpt-5.6-cyber` token limits and endpoints to match its model card (#49350) - Fixed `max_output_tokens` for Bedrock GovCloud West Llama 3 models, now 8192 (#49543) - Changed `converse-stream` pass-through to stream frames through post_call guardrails instead of buffering the reply (#46307) - Changed `/bedrock` pass-through routes to apply a model's `guardrailConfig`, returning 400 if Bedrock cannot use it (#47429) - Changed Bedrock pass-through to use request metadata as the session id, fixing 400s with `missing_session_id: reject` (#49193) - Changed Bedrock Invoke and Mantle Claude to use the model's own default `max_tokens` (#49724)
Vertex AI and Gemini (34) - Added Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS support, including multi-speaker voices and `mp3`, `opus`, `alaw` and `mulaw` output (#31915) - Added a setting to drop chosen `anthropic-beta` values on the Vertex AI pass-through routes (#47185) - Added `LITELLM_GEMINI_DEFAULT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS` to set the output limit for requests that set none (#47542) - Added `thought_signature_in_tool_call_id` to keep Gemini tool call ids short for clients that cap them (#47692) - Added a 2026-06-30 deprecation date to `vertex_ai/veo-2.0-generate-001` (#47847) - Added Batch rates for two Llama 4 MaaS models so Vertex batch jobs no longer bill at on-demand rates (#48085) - Added Vertex batch prices above 200k tokens and image output prices for Gemini models (#48945) - Fixed the Gemini 3 sampling deprecation warning logging on every request, now once per model per worker (#40868) - Fixed `vertex_ai/*` keys not listing partner, Veo and embedding models and dropping publisher prefixes (#41959) - Fixed Gemini TTS `/v1/audio/speech` calling Google twice and logging 0 tokens in spend (#44551) - Fixed 400 from compaction, thinking display and tool change betas on Claude via Vertex AI and Azure AI (#44747) - Fixed context caching on Vertex AI failing when a custom `api_base` is set (#44783) - Fixed streamed Vertex AI pass-through calls missing the regional 10% uplift and custom deployment prices (#44795) - Fixed Gemini not receiving integer enum values in tool parameters (#44908) - Fixed Vertex Claude batches returning 404 at create (#45715) - Fixed cache-marked requests listing all `cachedContents` on every call and creating duplicate caches (#46857) - Fixed Vertex AI rate limit errors returned as 403 when the error text contains 403 (#47134) - Fixed Gemini audio input and cached audio billed at the Standard rate on flex, priority and batch tiers (#48086) - Fixed `gemini-2.5-flash-native-audio` video input billed at the text rate instead of the audio/video rate (#48248) - Fixed Gemini 2.5 rejecting tool results with images and the history replay that follows (#48428) -
